retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica Underlay encompasses specialised resilient acoustic underlayment systems engineered to attenuate impact and airborne noise transmission beneath hard floor coverings and carpets. Designed for installation over concrete slabs and timber subfloors in multi-level residential and commercial buildings, these underlays decouple flooring finishes to achieve high AAAC star ratings and meet National Construction Code (NCC) acoustic criteria. They eliminate loud footfall thuds and clicking sounds, delivering long-term resilience and enhanced peace between adjoining dwellings.
